units.source_text: When the adult stance isn’t available, outside regulation or co-regulation may have to come first.
units.output_text: If you can't get yourself into that adult stance, then you will need to use some outside regulation.

units.source_text: That might mean a therapist, friend, support person, crisis line, group, or simply another safe adult presence helping with part of the job for a while.
units.output_text: This might require some co-regulation with another - whether that's a therapist, a trusted friend, a support person, a crisis line, a group or other.
